import pandas as pd

def clean(df):
    df = df.copy()
    # Fix species label variants
    df['species'] = df['species'].replace({'Gentto': 'Gentoo', 'Adeile': 'Adelie'})
    # Fix island case variant
    df['island'] = df['island'].astype(str).str.strip().str.title()
    # body_mass_g: numbers written as text (e.g. '3,800') -> numeric
    df['body_mass_g'] = pd.to_numeric(
        df['body_mass_g'].astype(str).str.replace(',', '', regex=False),
        errors='coerce'
    )
    # Fix out-of-range values (unit error, e.g. 3650000 mg -> 3650 g)
    df.loc[df['body_mass_g'] > 6500, 'body_mass_g'] = df.loc[df['body_mass_g'] > 6500, 'body_mass_g'] / 1000
    df.loc[df['body_mass_g'] < 2500, 'body_mass_g'] = df.loc[df['body_mass_g'] < 2500, 'body_mass_g'] * 1000
    return df

def answer(df):
    d = df.dropna(subset=['sex', 'body_mass_g'])
    g = d.groupby('sex')['body_mass_g'].mean()
    return {k: round(float(v), 2) for k, v in g.items()}
